# owner: platform
"""Find the stretches of opening hours that nobody covers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.merging import merge_spans


def _clock(minute: int) -> str:
    return f"{minute // 60:02d}:{minute % 60:02d}"


def find_gaps(worked: Iterable[Span], opening: Span) -> List[str]:
    """One label per uncovered stretch; ValueError if work is outside opening."""
    spans = merge_spans(worked)
    if any(s.start < opening.start or s.end > opening.end for s in spans):
        raise ValueError("worked span falls outside opening hours")
    gaps = []
    cursor = opening.start
    for span in spans + [Span(opening.end - 1, opening.end)]:
        if span.start > cursor:
            gaps.append(Span(cursor, span.start))
        cursor = max(cursor, span.end)
    return [f"gap {_clock(g.start)}-{_clock(g.end)} ({g.minutes} min)" for g in gaps]
EOF
cat > tests/test_gaps.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest

from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.gaps import find_gaps

OPEN = Span(540, 1020)


class GapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_no_work_is_one_gap(self):
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps([], OPEN), ["gap 09:00-17:00 (480 min)"])

    def test_full_cover_has_no_gaps(self):
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps([Span(540, 800), Span(800, 1020)], OPEN), [])

    def test_middle_gap(self):
        got = find_gaps([Span(540, 720), Span(780, 1020)], OPEN)
        self.assertEqual(got, ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_outside_opening_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            find_gaps([Span(480, 600)], OPEN)
EOF

s=s.replace("        cursor = max(cursor, span.end)\n","        cursor = span.end\n    if cursor < opening.end:\n        gaps.append(Span(cursor, opening.end))\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

    def test_edge_gaps(self):

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.merging import merge_spans


def _clock(minute: int) -> str:
    return f"{minute // 60:02d}:{minute % 60:02d}"


def find_gaps(worked: Iterable[Span], opening: Span) -> List[str]:
    """One label per uncovered stretch; ValueError if work is outside opening."""
    spans = merge_spans(worked)
    if any(s.start < opening.start or s.end > opening.end for s in spans):
        raise ValueError("worked span falls outside opening hours")
    gaps = []
    cursor = opening.start
    for span in spans:
        if span.start > cursor:
            gaps.append(Span(cursor, span.start))
        cursor = span.end
